mechanisms.name: The reader loses distinctions its own language documents require
mechanisms.classification: Source/document contradiction with bounded static counterexamples
mechanisms.observed_mechanism: File171 says negation reverses the requested answer, then calls bread/rising the whole question after stripping not. The reader removes listed negations from its carried subject; asked/kind metadata is not passed by answer() to deliver(). Its letters-only tokenizer discards numeric values, so changing 200C to 300C leaves the same lexical material. File173 demands number-plus-unit fidelity and warns about negation, quotation, hypothetical claims and direction. The separate core masks additionally discard word order and polarity as previously documented.
mechanisms.evidence_limits: The independent receipt checks text projection only; it does not run the organism or assert all system representations lose order. The contradiction is not fixed by retaining raw text in a receipt if the decision consumer still receives the reduced projection. File173’s requirement that an answer add new words is also an invalid universal acceptance predicate: a correct choice may repeat an offered alternative.
mechanisms.replacement: Specify the actual physical/retained distinctions needed for roles, quantities, negation, source attribution and temporal context. Prove they reach and influence the decision consumer. Retire the symbolic filtering authority rather than add exception lists, synthetic polarity flags or word-novelty scoring to emulate understanding.

acceptance.unit: Use paired polarity, role-order, magnitude/unit, quotation and hypothetical falsifiers tied to exact representations.
acceptance.module: Trace differing physical inputs through retained state and actual consumers; display any point where distinguishing information is lost.
acceptance.system: Show later grounded behavior distinguishes those experiences and survives retention, with independent negative controls.
acceptance.release: Qualify semantic claims only at the demonstrated causal scope; a new word or fluent sentence is not evidence of a correct answer.

mechanisms.classification: Historical policy migration, explicit failure lessons and authored output
mechanisms.observed_mechanism: Across these seven families, earlier versions contain 347 unique older-only passages totaling943 lines, predominantly removed CANNOT claims. The question family includes different greeting rules and ready-made CHUNKS (hello/morning/hi/good to see you/I am here/go on). The latest retains the broad MEANS-SAME lists. The inspected old core consumes CANNOT prose as rules, while saying.py separately builds authored greeting responses. Removing headings or moving policy between prose, chunks and Python changes authority; it is not automatically a semantic repair.
mechanisms.evidence_limits: All17 captured versions are content-reconciled. These are historical source transitions, not a deployment receipt or proof that every removed prohibition was sound. Some prohibitions are overbroad; blindly restoring all943 lines would reintroduce wrong policy. A documented retraction is useful evidence, not qualification of its successor.
mechanisms.replacement: Preserve predecessor content, original decisions and counterexamples. Distinguish genuine correction, corpus editorial change, behavior change and unsupported replacement. Retire authored pupil replies rather than move them into data; any allowed external greeting/tool must remain attributed and outside learned-speech evidence.
